---
title: "Benchmark"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup-benchmark
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
library(DT)
bench <- "../bench"
results <- if (file.exists(file.path(bench, "results.csv"))) read_csv(file.path(bench, "results.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
methods <- if (file.exists(file.path(bench, "summary", "methods.csv"))) read_csv(file.path(bench, "summary", "methods.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
cors <- if (file.exists(file.path(bench, "summary", "correlations.csv"))) read_csv(file.path(bench, "summary", "correlations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

The paper 1 benchmark (`make bench`, `make bench-report`) asks whether a vectorization that
looks right is also right to cut. It runs existing raster-to-vector methods on synthetic
papercraft templates with exact ground truth, at three raster qualities, and scores each result
with conventional visual metrics (raster IoU, chamfer and Hausdorff distance) and the
fabrication-aware metrics F1 to F5 from the paper. The `T-` rows are the ground truth with one
known defect added (an open contour, folds drawn as cuts, a 2 % scale error, 0.4 mm jitter), so
the metrics can be checked against errors of known size.

```{r}
#| label: benchmark-counts
#| output: asis
if (is.null(results)) {
  cat("The benchmark has not been run yet (bench/results.csv is missing).\n")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("%d templates, %d pages, %d raster conditions, %d methods.\n",
              n_distinct(results$template), n_distinct(paste(results$template, results$page)),
              n_distinct(results$condition), n_distinct(results$method)))
}
```

## Visual quality does not predict fabrication quality

```{r}
#| label: benchmark-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Each point is one page and method. Raster IoU (visual) against two fabrication metrics: share of correctly closed pieces (F1) and length difference between edges that are glued together (F5)."
#| fig-height: 4
if (!is.null(results)) {
  results |>
    filter(metric %in% c("raster_iou", "F1_closed", "F5_match_diff_mm")) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = value) |>
    pivot_longer(c(F1_closed, F5_match_diff_mm), names_to = "fabrication", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(kind = if_else(str_starts(method, "T-"), "perturbed truth", "existing method"),
           fabrication = recode(fabrication, F1_closed = "F1 closed pieces (share)",
                                F5_match_diff_mm = "F5 glue-edge mismatch (mm)")) |>
    ggplot(aes(raster_iou, value, colour = method, shape = kind)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~fabrication, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_hi() +
    labs(x = "raster IoU", y = NULL, colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    theme_hi() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

## Mean per method and condition

```{r}
#| label: benchmark-methods
#| column: page-right
if (!is.null(methods)) {
  methods |>
    select(method, condition, raster_iou, chamfer_mm, F1_closed, F2_dim_mm, F3_macro_f1,
           F4_duplicate_contours, F5_match_diff_mm, controls) |>
    datatable(rownames = FALSE, filter = "top", class = "compact stripe",
              options = list(pageLength = 25)) |>
    formatRound(c("raster_iou", "F1_closed", "F3_macro_f1", "F4_duplicate_contours"), 3) |>
    formatRound(c("chamfer_mm", "F2_dim_mm", "F5_match_diff_mm"), 3) |>
    formatRound("controls", 0)
}
```

## Spearman correlation between visual and fabrication metrics

```{r}
#| label: benchmark-correlations
if (!is.null(cors)) {
  cors |>
    filter(!is.na(spearman)) |>
    ggplot(aes(visual, fabrication, fill = spearman)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", spearman)), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~group) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = HI[["orange"]], mid = "white", high = HI[["blue"]], limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Spearman") +
    theme_hi()
}
```
